about: Patrols around a holding on the border, which widens what your realm can see.
calls_back: a new enemy army comes within radius

radius: how far around the holding to watch, in map units

when.if: army_near(at, radius) != none and army_near(at, radius) != reported
when.poke: {me}'s screen near {at} sees an enemy army: {army_near(at, radius)}, strength {strength_of(army_near(at, radius))}, {distance(army_near(at, radius), at)} from {at}.
